Comprehensive Export Services

OEM / Private Brand

Private Labeling & Custom Packaging

We empower international supermarkets, wholesale distributors, and restaurant chains to market premium Indian rice under their own private brand name. Our in-house design and packaging division handles complete bag artwork, multi-language nutritional facts, barcodes, and regulatory compliance.

BOPP Laminated Bags

High-gloss photographic printing in 5kg, 10kg, 20kg & 40kg.

Non-Woven Fabric Bags

Breathable eco-friendly bags with handles & zippers.

Traditional Jute Bags

Natural hessian jute bags for premium vintage aroma retention.

Bulk PP Sacks & Liners

Heavy duty 25kg & 50kg polypropylene woven sacks.

Global Shipping

Maritime Freight & Container Logistics

Operating directly from Mundra Port (Gujarat) and Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPT Mumbai), we maintain priority service contracts with premier ocean carriers including Maersk Line, MSC, CMA CGM, and Hapag-Lloyd.

FOB Mundra / JNPT

Loaded on board vessel at Indian port with all customs cleared and export duty paid.

CIF / CFR Destination

Ocean freight prepaid to buyer's destination port with full marine insurance coverage.

Fumigation Method Aluminum Phosphide / Methyl Bromide with 48h aeration
Desiccant Bags Container dry-pole silica gel bags to prevent sweat
Documentation & Inspection

Statutory Export Documentation & SGS Inspection

International trade requires absolute documentary precision. Our dedicated documentation team manages the complete dossier required for overseas customs clearance and bank negotiation under Letter of Credit.

  • Commercial Invoice & Packing List: Certified copies indicating net/gross weights and bag counts.
  • Certificate of Origin: Issued by Chamber of Commerce & Export Inspection Council.
  • Phytosanitary Certificate: Issued by Directorate of Plant Protection, Govt. of India.
  • SGS / Bureau Veritas Certificate: Independent pre-shipment quality and container seal report.
  • Clean on Board Ocean Bill of Lading: 3/3 original negotiable bills.
  • Fumigation & Health Certificate: Confirming cargo free of live pests and fit for human consumption.

Need Consignment Samples?

We dispatch 1kg to 2kg laboratory samples of our current milling batches via DHL Express or FedEx Air courier directly to international buyer offices within 3 business days.
